optimization_tips: Keep paid inference disabled until the deterministic dashboard and reports pass
Use a smaller capable model for explanation and reserve stronger models for complex cross-source investigations
Refresh cost details at most daily and query local snapshots for interaction
Use Cost Management Exports instead of repeated Cost Details calls for large recurring datasets
Scale Container Apps to zero outside demonstration windows
Sample traces and cap retention; never log raw billing rows or full prompts
Treat these values as envelopes and verify current prices before approving deployment
